title: ILC Galaxy Manifest
description: Schema for galaxy_manifest JSON files used by the ILC galaxy map viewer. Each entry represents one repo/package as a galaxy node in the meta-level 3D view.

id.description: Unique stable identifier for this galaxy

graph_path.description: Repo-relative path to the galaxy's node/edge JSON, or null if not loaded locally

signing_state.description: Signing and loading state of this galaxy

depends_on.description: List of galaxy ids this galaxy depends on (determines orbital depth)

color.description: Hex color string for the galaxy sprite (e.g. '#ffcc00')
